conventions.root: Keep the repository root limited to release, policy, and component entry points; classify new root entries intentionally.
conventions.naming: Preserve established package and research identifiers; use descriptive names and avoid accidental copy/download suffixes.
conventions.archive: Do not create or move material into an archive automatically; structural moves require human review.
conventions.release: Generated release artifacts belong in CI artifacts or GitHub Releases, never as tracked root files.

safety: The workflow may remove only unmistakable OS/editor/cache junk and may extend .gitignore with safe patterns. It never auto-moves or deletes substantive content.
